wuu.name: Shanghainese
wuu.about: The city's own Wu dialect, heard from older Shanghainese at home, in the lanes and at the morning market. Younger people mostly speak Mandarin and drop in a Shanghainese word or two. Spellings here are informal romanisations.

we: We, us, as in 'we Shanghainese' (阿拉)
